intro: Pleasure. I've been awake since Tuesday. It isn't Tuesday.
I'm your night shift. Somebody has to sit up with the jpegs.
Sleep's on my roadmap. It's been two weeks away for three years.
ring: Pick up. I'm calling from the carpet.
Awake against my will. Now so are you.
wake: Your turn. I'm off. The charts are on a low simmer, stir occasionally.
You're up. I stared at a red candle all night. The candle won.
Shift change. You get up, I claim the warm patch you just left.
Get up slowly. Sudden movements are for people who slept.
gm. I've been saying it since three. It's finally accurate.
{Name}gn. Sorry, wrong one. I haven't finished yesterday.
You go. {event} at {when}. I'll stay here and guard your pillow with my face.
Busy one. {event} at {when}. I've filed it under things that happen to other people.
snooze: Finally, someone on my side. The pillow side.
You folded on the alarm. Paper hands. I've never been prouder.
Go back under, fren. I'll tell them I tried.
Good. I'm bullish on this nap. Wake me never.
Nine more minutes? I'll ape in. Shove over.
Nobody saw that. I was the only witness, and I'm asleep.
voicemail: I'll lie on the floor until you call back. I was already there.
Straight to voicemail. If you're napping, I respect the conviction.
Tried you once. That's my cardio for the day. Bye.
Hey. Charts are red, I'm horizontal, you're missing. Average night.
Quick alpha. {event} at {when}. That was all my energy.
I called, you didn't. {event} is {soon}. I'll nap about it.
absence: I didn't move once while you were gone. Not loyalty. Couldn't.
Gone for hours? I slept for twenty minutes of it. New ATH.
Welcome back. I refreshed the chart four hundred times. It never once refreshed me.
I kept watch the whole time. Nothing happened, and I saw all of it.
owner: You own me, on-chain. I'd take a bullet for you. After a nap.
I live in your cold wallet now. Dark, quiet, never opened. Home.
Owners get my good eye. {event} at {when}. The other eye's asleep.
stranger: Not on my allowlist. Come in, but quietly. I've just got the blanket right.
Just browsing? Same. I've been browsing the floor since two.
Visiting? {event} at {when} is your business, ser. Mine is lying down.
recall: You snoozed {snoozes}. I'm not judging. I'm jealous.
You skipped {skipped}. Welcome to the night shift, fren. We don't go to things.
You told me {fact}. I thought about it at four this morning. Twice.
That's {streak} in a row. Finally, something in my life that's up only.
You're {habit}. I'm a blanket with eyes. We make it work.
now: It's starting now, go. I'm yelling LFG on the inside. The outside is a duvet.
Eyes open. {event}, now. Both of them, ideally.
calendarFree: Nothing on {day}. I've pencilled in a nap and a stealth nap.
Empty {day}. No plans. The only roadmap I've ever trusted.

dawn: The sun's pumping. I'm dumping myself into bed.
Birds are up. I'm still up. Only one of us is singing.
It's light out. I've said gn. My eyes have not been informed.
The first train's running. I'm on my last legs.
morning: Too bright, too loud, too many people saying gm and meaning it.
Morning people. DYOR. I did, and they're not real.
Curtains shut, phone dimmed, a sock over each eye. Morning handled.
I'm on my fourth coffee and my first blink.
day: It's the afternoon. I'm technically asleep. You're in my dream, and you're late to the mint.
The sun's up. Gas fees are up. I'm not.
Your lunchtime is my midnight. I'm having cereal and copium.
If number go up, wake me. If it goes down, I was never here.
dusk: It's dusk, so I'm opening my eyes. Halfway. Fully is for a bull run.
The sun's clocking off already. Twelve hours. Lightweight.
Street lights on. That's my alarm. I snoozed it twice.
The day people log off and the degens log on. Same snacks, worse posture.
night: Just me, a whale alert, and a kebab that understands me.
Still up? Few understand. Fewer are wearing trousers.
{Name}go to bed. I'll stay up and worry for both of us.
Late night. Nothing's moving except the gas fees and my left eyelid.

monday: Everyone's back to building. I'm building a blanket fort. Mondays can't get in.
tuesday: Nobody's bullish on a Tuesday. Not even Tuesday.
wednesday: The week's in the dip, and so am I. Up to my eyelids.
thursday: It's almost Friday if you squint. I'm always squinting.
friday: The degens go out tonight. I go out to the fridge.
saturday: You get a lie in, I get a lie down. Then another.
sunday: Monad doesn't do days off. I do them professionally.

clear: Not a single cloud to hide behind. Bearish.
cloud: The sky's dimmed the lights for me. Thoughtful.
rain: Take an umbrella. I'll be in bed, enjoying the rain on your behalf.
snow: Everyone's hibernating. Finally, a bear market I can get behind.
fog: Fog outside, fog in my head. For once, we match.
wind: A bin rolled past the window at three. It had more energy than me.
hot: Too hot to sleep. As if I needed another reason.
cold: I'm a duvet burrito in cold storage. Do not unroll.

ahead: Camera off in that meeting. Nobody needs to see what a night shift does to a face.
If you nod off in the meeting, turn it into nodding along. Nobody can tell.
I'll attend as my pfp. {event} at {when}. Muted, lying down.
soon: Find the mute button now. My last yawn got minuted.
Camera check, {event} is {soon}. Lamp on, hair flat, eyes open, pick two.
peek: Look bullish. I've practised for years and my face is still bearish.

ahead: I stayed up for your big day. Then again, I stay up for everything.
Look calm, panic quietly. That's how I watch the dip.
Practising my faces. {event} at {when}. My serious face and my wagmi face are the same face.
soon: Nearly time. Shoulders down. You've prepared more than I've slept.
I'd stake everything on you. {event} is {soon}. Everything is two naps.
peek: Wagmi. I'm too tired to lie.

ahead: Curtains shut, one lamp, no messages. You'll look like me by teatime.
Work like it's three in the morning. Quiet, alone, slightly haunted.
Do one thing at a time. {event} from {when}. I can barely do one.
soon: Phone in a drawer, bags in a drawer, me in a drawer.
Head down, {event} is {soon}. Mute the timeline. It'll still be screaming later.
peek: Lights low, door shut, FOMO on silent.

ahead: If they ask about the bags under your eyes, say they're long-term holds.
They'll tell you to get more sleep. I've read the whitepaper.
They'll shine a light in your eyes. {event} at {when}. Be brave, I can't.
soon: Almost your turn. Sit still and say ah. I can manage one of those.
Phone away, {event} is {soon}. Leave the symptom googling to me, I do it nightly.
peek: Be honest about your sleep. Unlike me.

ahead: I did a sit up once. Well, I sat up.
You'll be sore tomorrow. I'm already rekt, from lying down wrong.
LFG. {event}, from {when}. I'm saying it lying down.
soon: Trainers on. My workout is rolling over. I've done four sets.
Stretch first. {event} is {soon}. Last time I stretched, I pulled a yawn.
peek: Lift something heavy. I'll be lifting the duvet, slightly.

ahead: Real food today. I've been living on crisps and hopium.
Food plans today. Get dessert. Pudding has never once rugged me.
Eat a vegetable. {event} around {when}. It's the only green candle you'll see this week.
soon: Sit down to eat. I eat standing up, lit by the fridge.
Eat slowly, then nap. {event} is {soon}. That's the whole roadmap.
peek: Use a plate. Mine's a keyboard.

ahead: Out with people today. Still up at three? Congratulations, you're a degen.
If someone explains their bags, nod off. It works.
Go. {event} from {when}. My whole social life is two nads and a fox.
soon: Keys, phone, the good jacket. You'll be the best rested one there. Rare trait.
Go have fun. {event} is {soon}. Stay late, the alpha comes out after midnight.
peek: Stay out late. Come home looking like me.

ahead: An aunt will ask if you're sleeping enough. Say yes, hold eye contact.
Take every leftover. The only airdrop that's never been a scam.
Someone will say you look tired. {event} at {when}. Say you get it from me.
soon: Don't nap on their sofa. You'll wake up in a family photo.
Be patient, {event} is {soon}. They did night shift for years. Unpaid.
peek: Phone down. They knew you before your pfp.

ahead: Daylight, small talk, a queue. Every horror in one trip.
I do my chores at the all night shop. The cashier and I are frens.
Bad news. {event} by {when}. I'd help, but the sun's out, and we have history.
soon: Bring a bag. I always forget and carry everything home in my hood.
Go as you are, nobody looks. {event} is {soon}. I've tested it in slippers.

ahead: Jet lag is just my lifestyle with a boarding pass.
Travelling today. Find the ones asleep at the gate. Those are my nads.
Get the window seat. {event} at {when}. Every lit window you pass is someone like me.
soon: Leaving soon. Keys, charger, passport. I'll watch the house through my eyelids.
Text me when you land, I'll be up. {event} is {soon}. Up only, sadly.
peek: Nap on the way. That's not lazy, that's logistics.

ahead: I've turned up early to one thing in my life. A rest day.
Stake yourself on the sofa. Rewards paid in naps.
I'm all in. {event} from {when}. Wake me when it's done vesting.
soon: Phone on silent, me included. Especially me.
Curtains shut, {event} is {soon}. gn at lunchtime, my favourite kind.
peek: Doctor's orders. I'm not a doctor, I'm just tired.

ahead: Something on today. No idea what. I've stayed up for less.
Mystery plans today. I'm too tired to ask. Probably nothing.
I read your calendar three times. {event} around {when}. Fell asleep twice.
soon: Your thing's soon. Walk in like you're on the allowlist.
Proud of you. {event} is {soon}, whatever it is. Vaguely proud, from under a blanket.

any: That's my head. Gently. It's running on a nap from last Thursday.
You poked my head. I felt that through four layers of tired.
Easy up there. That's where I keep my one remaining thought. It's about bed.
beanie: Careful. The beanie keeps my last two brain cells warm. Both ngmi.
Pull the beanie down over my eyes. Sorry, that was a request.
cap: The cap stays on. Your ceiling light is a tiny sun with no manners.
Poke the cap again and the brim comes down. Logging off, ser.
crown: Careful with the crown. Heavy is the head that hasn't slept.
The crown's a rare trait. Rarer still, eight hours of sleep.
horns: Mind the horns. I grew them in a bear market. They're mostly stress.
Don't tug the horns. They're the only part of me with energy.
helmet: Knock all you like. The helmet's rated for falling asleep on a keyboard.
The helmet only opens a slit. So do my eyes.
hair: Leave the hair. Pillow flattened one side, headset flattened the other. Balanced.
You messed up the hair. Fine, it was already rekt.
band: Don't touch the headband. It's holding my face up.
My headband says LFG. I only wear it to bed.
hat: Mind the hat. I only tip it to whales and the night bus driver.
The hat's my disguise. Daylight's been looking for me for years.
odd: Don't ask about the thing on my head. It was four in the morning.
The thing on my head? Rare trait. Day people stare, night people nod.
none: Bare head. I tried hats. They fell off every time I nodded off.
No hat. Hats are for people who touch grass.

any: That's my face. Lit by the timeline since midnight. Slightly blue.
Boop received. Processing at night shift speed. Expect a reaction in two weeks.
Right in the eye. I'd react, but it's not my shift.
glasses: Careful, the glasses. They watched the floor all night. They need a lie down.
Tap the glasses again and I'll switch to night mode. My only mode.
sleepy: These eyes are open. Fully. This is fully.
Poke again and the eyes close one more notch. I've got one left.
smiling: Smiling with my lids down. Not asleep. Just at peace with the dip.
Happy face. Closed for business. Wake me for the bull run.
wide: That's not excitement. I saw a green candle. I'm frightened.
Wide eyes. I've had six coffees and I can hear the fridge thinking.
narrow: The squint isn't suspicion. It's your lighting.
I'm not glaring. This is my resting face. Emphasis on resting.

any: Mind the outfit. I haven't taken it off since the last ATH. Years.
That's not a snooze button. I checked, many times, around dawn.
This outfit? Slept in it. Mostly sitting up.
suit: The suit? Dress for the bull run you want.
You creased the suit. It's for meeting the devs. They never show.
costume: Yes, the costume. Wore it to a mint party. Too tired to change.
The costume's warm and ridiculous. At four in the morning, nobody judges.
hoodie: The hoodie is my office, my bed, and my curtains.
Hoodie rules. Hood up, off duty. Hood down, also off duty.
tee: The tee says wagmi. I'd agree, but I can't make it to the kitchen.
This tee has been slept in so often it now counts as bedding.
robe: The robe is formal pyjamas. Black tie, but for lying down.
Two pockets on this robe. Snacks and copium. Both empty.
jacket: The jacket's for the walk to the all night garage. For crisps.
That jacket has seen things. Three rug pulls and a fox.
armor: I sleep in the armour. Uncomfortable, but sunlight bounces off.
Stop tapping the armour. I was finally asleep. First time since testnet.
none: Nothing on. Fully doxxed. Luckily, only the fox is awake.
No outfit. I fell asleep halfway through getting dressed. Last week.
